title: Magnetic pointer attraction on dock buttons
blurb: Five interactive HTML dock buttons inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas pull toward your cursor or finger with liquid edge stretch, curving field lines and elastic recoil on escape.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas pull five live drawable HTML dock buttons toward a pointer with directional liquid stretch, glowing magnetic flux lines, damped spring recoil past an escape threshold and updateElementGeometry() hit testing?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass on one ElementGL context (0.79 MP, 6.35 MB), readPixels() confirms pulled tile displacement and Pass 0 flux glow, escape crossing recoils +7.8 px, and updateElementGeometry() aligns displaced clicks. Android Chrome 159 and check:jank stay not verified.
